stem: Which condition is a whole chromosomal aneuploidy?
explanation: Trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome) is a whole chromosomal aneuploidy because it results from an extra copy of an entire chromosome.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes

optionExplanations.A: Correct because trisomy 18 is caused by an additional whole chromosome, making it a chromosomal aneuploidy.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because Fragile X syndrome is a single-gene disorder caused by CGG repeat expansion, not a whole chromosomal aneuploidy.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because CHARGE syndrome is a named multiple congenital anomaly syndrome, not an aneuploidy.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because neurofibromatosis type 1 is a single-gene disorder, not a whole chromosomal aneuploidy.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because tuberous sclerosis is a single-gene neurocutaneous disorder, not a whole chromosomal aneuploidy.
